DEVICE_TIME.description: Result of BC-50 cmd62 (read device clock). device_time is mandatory; drift_seconds is signed (positive = device ahead of host).

operation_id.description: Correlation ID matching the originating command request.

device_time.description: Fiscal device clock time as reported by cmd62. Never substituted with host clock.

drift_seconds.description: Signed drift: device_time minus host_time in seconds. Positive = device ahead.
